name: HYROS
description:
Hyros tracks every ad click, lead, and sale, so you can see which campaigns, ads, and keywords actually produce revenue. This connector brings that data into Claude.

Ask in plain language and get answers from your live Hyros account:

• "Which Meta campaigns had the best ROAS last month?"
• "What were my best performing ads last month?"
• "Where did last week's revenue actually come from?"
• "Show me an overview of the last 7 days"

Claude can pull attribution reports, spend and ROAS by campaign or ad set, lead and customer journeys, revenue and LTV breakdowns, and call and booking data, then chart it, summarize it or drop it into the doc you're already writing.

Built for media buyers, agencies, and growth teams who spend their days reconciling ad platform numbers against what actually hit the bank account.

Requires an active Hyros account. You connect with your Hyros login, and Claude only sees data that account already has access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HYROS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HYROS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hyros.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HYROS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HYROS lists 60 MCP tools, including hyros_assert_script_presence_on_domain, hyros_check_tracking_parameters_for_integrations, hyros_create_call, hyros_create_cart, hyros_create_click, hyros_create_conversion_definition, hyros_create_custom_conversion, hyros_create_custom_cost, hyros_create_lead, hyros_create_order, hyros_create_product, and hyros_create_source.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HYROS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HYROS in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
HYROS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HYROS is developed by Hyros. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
